type Thread {
  id: Int!
  title: String
  body(
    asHtml: Boolean
  ): String
  userId: Int!
  replyUserId: Int
  replyCommentId: Int
  replyCount: Int
  viewCount: Int
  isLocked: Boolean
  isSticky: Boolean
  isSubscribed: Boolean
  likeCount: Int!
  isLiked: Boolean
  repliedAt: Int
  createdAt: Int!
  updatedAt: Int!
  user: User
  replyUser: User
  likes: [User]
  siteUrl: String
  categories: [ThreadCategory]
  mediaCategories: [Media]
}
